facts: The historical Core export is a complete point-in-time set of data and tables with a relational design.
Historical Names and Address tables join through EntityID; there is no exported Entity table and an entity can have multiple names and addresses.
Historical NTypeID = 1 identifies the Legal NC name.
Historical PitemID identifies the unique corporate profile; CorpNum is not unique because the combined systems can duplicate it.
